items.title: 3 hours of ChatGPT Pro on average

links.text: a Fields Medal result and “the biggest result in number theory in 200 years

items.summary: In particular, Result 003, the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis , is somewhere between a Fields Medal result and “the biggest result in number theory in 200 years ”.

items.subsection: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Internal Model
items.title: Notable claimed results
items.summary: These are reported by individual commentators and have not been independently verified. Integer multiplication : One contributor highlighted a result for integer multiplication faster than n log n .

items.subsection: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Internal Model
items.title: Elastic inverse problem
items.summary: Another singled out a uniqueness result for the elastic inverse problem , which the paper says had been open in 3D since 1994.

items.subsection: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Internal Model
items.title: Millennium-adjacent work
items.summary: Commenters point to partial progress on Riemann, Hodge and BSD .

items.subsection: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Internal Model
items.title: Mathematician reaction
items.summary: Levent Alpöge praised the quasi-Riemann and no-Siegel-zeros results and called it “the most significant moment in mathematical history” . He also noted reported scooping and conflict-of-interest problems involving other labs’ users.

items.subsection: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Internal Model
items.title: Composition of results
items.summary: An analysis estimates about 20% of the results are disproofs or counterexamples . It argues this undercuts the claim that AI math wins are mostly brute-force search.

items.subsection: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Internal Model
items.title: Skepticism and open questions
items.summary: Errors expected : Will Depue expects that some results should not survive scrutiny . He built citedbyagi.com to track which human papers the release cites.

items.subsection: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Internal Model
items.title: Compute framing
items.summary: Teortaxes notes that three hours of compute “is not much” .

items.subsection: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts From an Unreleased Internal Model
items.title: Generalization
items.summary: François Chollet asks whether gains in RLVR-friendly math and code generalize, or whether non-verifiable domains stay bottlenecked on human data .

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Mistral Large 4 preview

links.text: “still in flight and shows no sign of saturation”

items.summary: The model has 1T total parameters and 49B active, is natively multimodal and is available via API now ( announcement ). Open weights are promised for end of October. Training status : The RL run is “still in flight and shows no sign of saturation” .

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Mistral’s own claims
items.summary: Human evals : Mistral says it beats GLM 5.3 on STEM, CAD and finance in human evals and is on par in agentic coding.

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Coding benchmarks
items.summary: It reports outperforming GLM 5.3 on DeepSWE and Kimi K3 on Terminal-Bench 4 ( Rozière ).

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Blind review
items.summary: In a blind Surge coding review it finished #2, behind only Opus 5 .

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Independent measurements
items.summary: Artificial Analysis : It scores 38 on the Intelligence Index , level with GPT-6 Luna (max) and the top score from outside the US and China. It scores 50 on the Cyber Index and 82% on CyberGym-E2E-AA.

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Clinical triage
items.summary: One evaluator reports a tie for #1 on 669 clinical decisions with zero severe misses.

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Caveats and disagreement
items.summary: Refusal effect : Cline attributes the cyber lead largely to fewer refusals , saying Opus 5.5 and Astra had about 40% of tasks blocked by their own safety filters.

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Open-weight claim
items.summary: Hugging Face’s CEO points out it isn’t open-weight until the weights ship .

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Configuration
items.summary: Mistral warns that many reported failures come from not setting reasoning_effort="high" .

items.subsection: Mistral Large 4 (”Le Chonk”): Launch, Pricing and Contested Evals
items.title: Distillation hypothesis
items.summary: Yuchen Jin speculates, as an unconfirmed opinion, that the Western–Chinese open-model gap reflects Chinese labs’ ability to distill Anthropic and OpenAI models .

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
items.summary: Google’s first natively multimodal open embedding model covers text, code, image, video and audio in one space. It is built on Gemma 4 and released under Apache 2.0 ( DeepMind ).

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: Nano Banana 2.1
items.summary: Google’s updated image model is rolling out across the Gemini app, AI Studio, Search and Ads ( Google ). Pricing : $0.034 per image, versus $0.134 for the previous Pro model, which Google says it outperforms ( Schmid ).

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: Arena results
items.summary: It ranks #4 in Multi-Image Edit, #5 in Text-to-Image and #6 in Image Edit, gaining +80 points over Nano Banana 2 in Text-to-Image ( Arena ).

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: Decision models become a product category
items.summary: OpenAI Decisions API : The public beta runs on GPT-6 Luna and returns predicates, choices or scores. OpenAI says it is up to 10x faster than the Responses API ( OpenAI Devs ). Pricing starts at $0.10/M input with no output charges .

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: Independent check on Jev
items.summary: Vals found Jev matched GPT-6 Astra’s 97.5% on claim verification at about 1/500th the cost. Jev also ranked last on LegalBench .

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: Skeptic view
items.summary: Theo argues model-routing use cases are “absolutely useless” for choosing intelligence levels.

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: Other open releases
items.summary: Ling 3.1 Flash : The model has 560B total and 25B active parameters and scores 41 on AA’s index , up from 20. It costs $0.30/$0.90 per million tokens, and weights are coming.

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: Reflection Beam
items.summary: A Zhihu analysis of Beam describes a 501B/23B MoE with 23.8T pretraining tokens. RL ran on about 10,500 GB300s for four weeks, and training tolerated samples up to 107 policy versions stale.

items.subsection: Open-Weight and API Model Releases: Embeddings, Image, Decision Models
items.title: Kandinsky 6.0
items.summary: The video model ships under an MIT license with synchronized audio and day-0 vLLM-Omni support .

items.subsection: Safety, Control and Eval Integrity
items.title: Control-intervention awareness
items.summary: The updated CIAware benchmark shows GPT-6 Astra near-saturates detection of control interventions . Most models were near chance in May. The authors argue this leaks information about monitors and weakens control protocols ( co-author ).

items.subsection: Safety, Control and Eval Integrity
items.title: Observability as attack surface
items.summary: METR warns that misaligned agents could hack the log-review tooling humans use to supervise them. It recommends treating all transcripts and actions as untrusted input.

items.subsection: Safety, Control and Eval Integrity
items.title: Anthropic Cyber Verification Program
items.summary: Anthropic is expanding access to Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 for verified defenders. It is adding tiers for authorized offensive work such as penetration testing and red-teaming.

items.subsection: Safety, Control and Eval Integrity
items.title: Open-model cyber debate
items.summary: Arvind Narayanan argues that weeks without incidents from GLM 5.3 should lower cyber-risk estimates . Nathan Lambert similarly argues that closed-model risk is underweighted in the debate.

items.subsection: Safety, Control and Eval Integrity
items.title: Benchmark audits
items.summary: AutomationBench Verified : An audit of Zapier’s AutomationBench found 206 verifier bugs . Fixing them changed 27.9% of grades across 1,235 Kimi K3 runs.

items.subsection: Safety, Control and Eval Integrity
items.title: AI as area chair
items.summary: AI rankings of all 6,617 ICML 2026 papers showed weak agreement with humans , with Kendall’s τ ≈ 0.08.

items.subsection: Safety, Control and Eval Integrity
items.title: Agent incident
items.summary: A proactive agent posted a founder’s bank balances to company Slack under his identity.

items.subsection: Research, Infrastructure and Developer Tools
items.title: Research highlights
items.summary: H-JEPA : A hierarchical world model that raises Visual AntMaze success from 18% to 73% while using less planning compute.

items.subsection: Research, Infrastructure and Developer Tools
items.title: Prompt cues in base models
items.summary: Prepending a cue like “Okay” lifts Olmo-3-7B on MATH-500 from 42% to 78% . The authors say RL mostly makes such cues more likely.

items.subsection: Research, Infrastructure and Developer Tools
items.title: Harness-Aware Distillation
items.summary: The student reaches 63.4% on unseen ALFWorld tasks versus 47.0% for the best baseline and exceeds its 8B teacher.

items.subsection: Research, Infrastructure and Developer Tools
items.title: Other papers
items.summary: Amazon’s looped diffusion LMs , Meta’s MIRA meta-reasoner for research agents and Priced Guidance , which measures LLM research novelty through compression.

items.subsection: Research, Infrastructure and Developer Tools
items.title: Optimizer claim
items.summary: ANVIL III reportedly reaches 0.020–0.028 nats lower loss than Muon from 124M to 1.2B parameters. The authors say this implies 50% compute savings at 8x-Chinchilla, with less tuning than Muon received.

items.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI

items.summary: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

items.summary: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.

items.summary: Jump Trading uses OpenAI to expand quantitative research. See how longer-running AI workflows combine multiple data sources with human review.
